phase_name: CHGR Cross-Artifact Digest-Binding and Duplicate-Match Verification Repair
summary: Phase 146L repaired src/pcae/governance/verification.py's related-artifact resolver per Phase 146K's frozen CHGR-001 v1.3 Sec.30 Model C (Directed One-Way Integrity Binding). Independently reconfirmed both Sec.2 Blocking defects live against the current repository state, before any code change, using two genuine build_publication_record bundles: (A) duplicate-match ambiguity -- a second self-consistent same-record_id confirmation candidate produced an order-dependent result (verified one order, CONFIRMATION_UNBOUND the other); (B) digest-reference bypass -- a bundle-B confirmation sibling retargeted to bundle A's record_id and re-signed was accepted (outcome=verified) through both the internal API and the real pcae governance-record verify CLI, despite supplied_sibling.record_digest != target_reference.record_digest. Replaced the prior _find_related closure (first-match on record_type+record_id, argument-order-dependent) with a new _resolve_related resolver: identifies every supplied candidate sharing the referenced record_id, fails closed on zero-or-many matches (CHGR-REQ-213, including byte-identical duplicates, checked before any candidate is validated), enforces family identity, and -- for the confirmation and provenance roles only -- enforces exact record_digest equality against the Human Governance Record's own reference (CHGR-REQ-212). The integrity role passes enforce_reference_digest=False, preserving the already-implemented directed one-way binding (CHGR-REQ-211: integrity.payload_digest == human_governance_record.record_digest) and never comparing integrity_ref.record_digest against the resolved artifact's own digest, proven by a dedicated source-inspection regression test as well as by fixture-level behavior, satisfying CHGR-REQ-215 legacy compatibility without migration. Three new stable error codes added to the existing nine: RELATED_ARTIFACT_AMBIGUOUS, RELATED_ARTIFACT_FAMILY_MISMATCH, REFERENCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH -- DIGEST_MISMATCH retained, unextended, for self-inconsistency/tampering and the integrity payload_digest binding. Both defects re-verified fixed post-repair via the same live-bundle harness (API and real CLI subprocess). Three pre-existing test fixtures (valid_record_published.json, valid_integrity.json, adversarial_assurance_overclaim_selfconsistent.json) migrated to carry real matching reference digests -- a shape the schema always allowed but the verifier never content-checked before this phase, mirroring the 146H.3 precedent. Six 146H.3 unit tests updated via a new _rereferenced test helper (re-points the record's own reference alongside a mutate-then-resign step) to keep isolating their intended downstream semantic check now that exact reference-digest matching gates ahead of it; the _ERROR_CODES exact-set assertion in test_chgr_verification.py updated from nine to twelve members. 45 new tests added in tests/test_phase_146l_chgr_cross_artifact_digest_binding_and_duplicate_match_verification_repair.py covering the full confirmation/provenance/integrity/bundle-level/live-production-bundle/legacy-compatibility adversarial matrix. No change to CHGR-001, CHGR schemas, the schema manifest, publication construction (governance/publication/record.py untouched), the Publication Coordinator, persistence, Interactive Workflow, or lifecycle sequencing. Full detail in docs/PHASE_146L_CHGR_CROSS_ARTIFACT_DIGEST_BINDING_AND_DUPLICATE_MATCH_VERIFICATION_REPAIR.md.
tests_added_or_updated: 45 new tests in tests/test_phase_146l_chgr_cross_artifact_digest_binding_and_duplicate_match_verification_repair.py; tests/test_chgr_verification.py updated (2 tests: full-positive-chain assertion unaffected in substance, _ERROR_CODES exact-set assertion widened from nine to twelve codes and renamed); tests/test_phase_146h3_confirmation_binding_verification_repair.py updated (6 tests re-pointed via a new _rereferenced helper so the new exact reference-digest gate does not preempt the specific downstream semantic check each test isolates); three fixtures migrated (valid_record_published.json, valid_integrity.json, adversarial_assurance_overclaim_selfconsistent.json).
